summary: @jay_hoffman starting a new thread as I feel it wasn't my place to comment on how PoC use Twitter. I do think we need to get away from this idea of "winning" The sports and war metaphors baked into capitalism are what lead to engagement metrics that favor outrage.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@jay_hoffman starting a new thread as I feel it wasn't my place to comment on how PoC use Twitter.

I do think we need to get away from this idea of "winning"

The sports and war metaphors baked into capitalism are what lead to engagement metrics that favor outrage.
